description: Defines the FuzzedDatagramClientSocket class, a mock implementation of DatagramClientSocket for fuzz testing, including methods for connection, reading, writing, and socket configuration.

classes.name: FuzzedDatagramClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket class for fuzz testing, simulating connection, read/write operations, and socket configuration with randomized behavior.

methods.name: FuzzedDatagramClientSocket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket with a data provider for fuzzing.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetwork
methods.description: Connects using a specified network handle.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Connects using the default network.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to connect to an endpoint.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connects using a specified network handle.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connects using the default network.

methods.name: GetBoundNetwork
methods.description: Returns the network handle the socket is bound to.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for traffic management.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote peer address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address.

methods.name: UseNonBlockingIO
methods.description: Enables non-blocking I/O mode.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the multicast interface by index.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log source.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, with callback for completion.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer, with callback for completion and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the receive buffer.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the send buffer.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets the socket to not fragment packets.

methods.name: SetMsgConfirm
methods.description: Sets message confirmation mode (no implementation).
